messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: Sixth protocol. A simulated outage cuts part of the laboratory. The creature detects the fault before our instruments.

choices.label: I immediately protect the incubation room.
I analyze the outage before moving.
I follow the creature toward the source of the fault.

messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: It understands locks faster than expected. If it wanted to, it could open half the laboratory.

choices.label: I forbid it from approaching the security systems.
I ask it to choose only one lock to open.
I map the paths it seems to perceive.

messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: Command is requesting full containment. I need to know whether you still consider this creature a test subject.

choices.label: I obey containment: risk comes before the bond.
I negotiate a looser protocol to avoid panic.
I let it show the exit it perceives.
